summary: Retevis RT22 CPS V1.05: tone OFF is FF FF (encoder 0x40DAAE/0x40DBA4; decoder shows hi byte FF as OFF); CTCSS binary x10, DCS 0x28xx/0xA8xx octal. Writes every 16-byte block 0x000-0x3E0 (incl. ID block 0x000); reads 0x360 first and compares a 6-byte password with the file (0x4024A5). Never touches channel bytes 12/14/15. Desktop CHIRP already uses tone_init 0xFFFF; Web Programmer wrote 00 00.
